snippet.title: Insanidade? [English Subtitles] (No Commentary Longplay)
snippet.description:
ABOUT THE GAME:
Insanidade is a Brazilian indie horror game released in 2013. It was quite popular at the time and was played by several well-known YouTubers.

Five years ago, a man lost everything—the love of his life, his sanity, and his grip on reality. Haunted by the brutal murder of his wife and consumed by guilt, he discovers the man responsible has been confined to a remote asylum known as Angels’ Refuge. With nothing left to lose, he sets out on a twisted journey seeking revenge and answers.

But as he delves deeper into the asylum’s decaying halls, strange and unexplainable events begin to unfold. Shadowy figures watch from the darkness, cryptic messages hint at a deeper conspiracy, and reality itself seems to bend and fracture. Who can he trust? What is real, and what is a product of his unraveling mind?

Confronting both the horrors within the asylum and the demons inside himself, the man must piece together the truth behind his wife’s death—and his own fractured psyche.

Will you uncover the secrets of Angels’ Refuge, or will you succumb to the madness lurking within?

You can also watch a version of this video with the original text in Brazilian Portuguese here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=51SJZ6-c81U

Note: The English subtitles shown in the video were added during editing and are not a feature of the game.

DEVELOPER: IndieArte
PUBLISHER: IndieArte
AVAILABLE ON: Itch.io 
RELEASE YEAR: 2013
SYSTEM: PC / Windows
